scope: CTAP largeBlobs segmented output using wire-provisioned deterministic4096-byte data. Exact bytes on actual pinned C and Rust transports; no storage fault, physical USB/RF/WTX or CIU resource acceptance.

cases.preconditions: Fresh throwaway storage, no PIN, alwaysUv false. Blob is uploaded through CTAP SET with SHA256 checksum; no file injection. Configured USB or activated NFC; HID IN drains per event. NFC CRC is chip-validated; no physical timing or storage faults modeled.
